verses.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

segments.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is
For brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.text: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;

segments.text: It is like the precious oil upon the head,
That ran down upon the beard,
That came down upon the skirt of his garments;

verses.text: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.

segments.text: That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion:
For there Jehovah commanded the blessing,

headings.text: A Song of Ascents; of David.
